description: PRO KEY ONLY. Complete public history of changes (prices, availability, corrected values), beyond the 50 of `get_recent_changes`, filterable by robot (`slug`), kind and dates (`from`, `to`, YYYY-MM-DD). Paged with `offset`; `locale: "fr"` for French sentences. Without a pro key the answer points to https://vuntum.com/en/business#demande.

limit.description: Maximum number of changes (100 by default, 200 max).

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

offset.description: Number of changes to skip, to read the next page.

name: get_change_history
title: Full change history (pro key)
